authority: agent-authored evaluation definitions; no new human factual review
tag_population: overlapping tags; never sum as exclusive errors
semantic_cause: unknown unless fixture truth or explicit reviewed evidence establishes it

review_outcomes.change_warranted: An explicit anchor establishes an incorrect unit and supports the proposed change.
review_outcomes.no_change_warranted: An explicit anchor establishes that the existing unit is correct.
review_outcomes.abstain: Evidence is insufficient for the requested decision; no correctness credit is granted.
review_outcomes.not_reviewed: No applicable review anchor exists; rates are unavailable.

definitions.harmful_change: correct-to-wrong transition on an anchored unit
definitions.unnecessary_change: alteration of an anchored correct unit
definitions.false_support: claiming support for an anchored contradicted unit
definitions.false_acceptance: claiming acceptability for an anchored incorrect unit

anchor_policy.existing_gold: exact field comparison only; no implied source-support judgment
anchor_policy.synthetic: declared technical oracle, reported separately from gold and human judgments
anchor_policy.human_reviewed: requires explicit reviewer, evidence reference, decision and version
anchor_policy.unknown: excluded from accuracy denominators and retained in coverage populations
